question: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.
sql:
-- Final query: distinct player names who scored >= 100 runs for the losing team in a match
WITH match_losing_teams AS (
    SELECT match_id,
           CASE WHEN team_1 != match_winner THEN team_1 ELSE team_2 END AS losing_team
    FROM match
),
striker_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bbb.match_id,
        bbb.striker AS player_id,
        bbb.team_batting,
        bbb.innings_no,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) AS runs_scored
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
),
player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        sr.match_id,
        sr.player_id,
        SUM(sr.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM striker_runs sr
    JOIN match_losing_teams mlt ON sr.match_id = mlt.match_id
    WHERE sr.team_batting = mlt.losing_team
    GROUP BY sr.match_id, sr.player_id
    HAVING SUM(sr.runs_scored) >= 100
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM player_match_runs pmr
JOIN player p ON pmr.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY p.player_name

WITH match_losing_teams AS (
    SELECT match_id,
           CASE WHEN team_1 != match_winner THEN team_1 ELSE team_2 END AS losing_team
    FROM match
),
striker_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bbb.match_id,
        bbb.striker AS player_id,
        bbb.team_batting,
        bbb.innings_no,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) AS runs_scored
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
),
player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        sr.match_id,
        sr.player_id,
        SUM(sr.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM striker_runs sr
    JOIN match_losing_teams mlt ON sr.match_id = mlt.match_id
    WHERE sr.team_batting = mlt.losing_team
    GROUP BY sr.match_id, sr.player_id
    HAVING SUM(sr.runs_scored) >= 100
)
SELECT pmr.match_id, pmr.player_id, p.player_name, pmr.total_runs
FROM player_match_runs pmr
